question.nlq: Hey there! I'm trying to dig up all the super popular posts that were written by power users who've racked up tons of badges. Could you do me a favor and show me the post titles along with how many views each one's gotten?

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT p.Title, p.ViewCount
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE p.ViewCount > 5000
GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title, p.ViewCount
HAVING COUNT(b.Id) >= 15
